name: @argszero/dsh-activation-doctor
description: Writes the activation report the harness already composes but never files. When a third-party plugin fails to activate — most often because a tool or prompt-section name it registers is already taken — the fiber that threw is unloaded whole, so every tool and prompt section it contributed disappears, and the only record is one line on stderr: the persistent report under $DSH_HOME/logs is written for required-entry failures only, and the desktop shell keeps backend stderr in a 64 KiB buffer it attaches to an exit error. This plugin sweeps the loader's entries after the tree settles, awaits each fiber to recover the original error and stack, classifies disabled / import-failed / failed / pending-waiting-for-a-service, writes a private report under $DSH_HOME/logs, prints a one-line summary, re-reports failures that appear later (hot reload, profile patch re-application), and answers activation_status on demand. It is a detector, not a repairer: it does not revive the failed plugin, change the marketplace row, or move the desktop's stderr. Zero runtime dependencies beyond the harness itself, and it never touches the plugin that failed.
